title: US stocks today: US stocks end higher as strong inflation data cements rate-hike bets
text: US stocks today: US stocks end higher as strong inflation data cements rate-hike bets. US stocks ended higher on Friday as accelerating consumer prices strengthened expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike next week. The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all gained, while Dell surged to a record high. Oil prices fell but remained sharply higher for the week amid concerns over Middle East supply disruptions.
